summary.text: Chris Keyser is a Republican state representative from Vermont's Rutland-7 District who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A business owner, he is a Tufts University graduate.

paragraphs.text: Chris Keyser was born in Chelsea, Vermont.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Tufts University and has worked as a business owner.
Keyser was first elected in 2024, when he defeated incumbent Democrat William Notte, 57.9 percent to 41.9 percent, and took office on January 8, 2025.
He advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
